title: Conformance corpus case
description: One portable conformance case: a reference to a standalone document model (modelRef), an instance (placements), an operation, and the kernel-verified expected outcome. The normative contract is docs/CONFORMANCE-CORPUS-SPEC.md; this schema is its machine-readable shape. Executable validation of every committed case is CorpusSchemaGuardTest (which parses each file through the same reference (de)serializer a runner uses, resolves every modelRef, and loads every models/*.json).

id.description: Unique case id; equals the file stem.

kernelVersion.description: The kernel version the expectations were captured against.

sections.description: The KERNEL-SEMANTICS taxonomy sections the case exercises (the navigation join key).

tags.description: Free labels. A case with a validatePart op MUST carry "partial".

notes.description: One human sentence on what the case pins.

modelRef.description: Corpus-root-relative path of the case's standalone DM-JSON model file (e.g. "models/order-basic.json"), shared across cases. The file is expanded, self-contained DM-JSON with rules/computations embedded as stored-English condition strings — no wrapper envelope, so it opens in the A12 modeling tools and feeds dmtool directly.

clock.description: A single local wall-clock instant (yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss, no zone); present iff evaluation touches Today/Now.

placements.description: The instance as an ordered placement list (a serialized PlacementSink); parent row before its contents.

reps.description: One 1-based index per path segment, the addressed segment included.

relevant.description: validatePart only: the relevant instance pointers (path + one index per segment).

expected.description: validate ops: the sorted code|type|pointer signature multiset (an empty array is a real assertion).

computeExpected.description: compute op: the sorted pointer|VALUE|value / pointer|CLEARED / pointer|ERRORED multiset.

divergences.description: Per-strategy expectation overrides against the groovy-dynamic anchor (full replacement, the op's key).
